1. To consider and approve the appointment of Mr.Sandeep Narayan Ghatad as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Independent) of the Company, subject to the approval of the
shareholders.

3. To consider and approve the appointment of Mr.Obed Bhaskar Sonar as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Independent) of the Company, subject to the approval of the shareholders.
4. To consider and approve the reconstitution / restructuring of various Committees of the Board of Directors of the Company.
5. Any other business with the permission of the Chair.

Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("LODR Regulations"), we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, November 14, 2026, has inter alia considered, approved, and taken on record the following:

1. Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and the Statement of Cash Flows as of September 30, 2026.

2. Limited Review Report on the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the half-year ended September 30, 2026.

KMS Medisurgi Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulation 29 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 1:00 pm at the registered office of the Company to consider and approve:
1. The Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended 30th September, 2026 and the Limited review report thereon;
2. Any other items, if any.
Further, in terms of Company''s "Code of Conduct for Prevention of Insider Trading", the closure of trading window for purchase/sale of securities of the Company by the Designated persons and their immediate relatives has already commenced from October 1, 2026 and will end Forty-Eight (48) hours after the declaration of Financial Results of the Company for the Half year ended on 30th September, 2026.
